name: Imo Imo Communication ~Onii-chan, Otona no Asobi Shiyo?~
original_name: 妹々こみにゅけ～しょん ～おにいちゃん、大人の遊びシよ?～

Ah… Nao. Nao was on top of me.
I didn’t know why, but there she was, sitting on me while I was asleep.
That wasn’t all.

Sex… feels this good… Ahhh… Hey, big bro… Are you close?
When guys have sex, they release sperm, right? It feels so amazing… Ahhh…
The first time can be tough, right?
I think I’m about to… I’m gonna cum… Ughhh…"

"Eh? Sis, what are you doing? Ahhh!
Sis, with your own brother?.. Why? You said you’d help me!"

"Ah, well… This is just a little test… you know?"

"Well, I thought maybe Makoto might find big bro too big, so I was checking for her.
I’m the experienced one, after all. I think it might be too much for Makoto, though. If she’s okay with it hurting…"

"Yeah…"
